links.outcome: Lay comprehension, reading time, and consultation time for original vs GPT-4 simplified radiology reports
links.effect: Comprehension scores rose from 5.51 to 7.83 (P<.001); consultation time fell from 1116.11 to 745.30 seconds (P<.001); reading rate rose from 72.15 to 104.70 words per minute.
links.quote: Physician-patient communication time significantly decreased, from 1116.11 seconds to 745.30 seconds (P<.001), and patient comprehension scores improved from 5.51 to 7.83 (P<.001).

screen.reason: Evaluated the impact of LLM-based simplification of radiology reports on patient comprehension and doctor-patient communication in simulated consultations.
